name: quay_ask
description: Ask the operator one to four questions beside this terminal, when you need a decision or an answer before you go on. The call stays open for the answer, up to 100 seconds, and returns {"answers": [{"question", "chosen", "text"}]}, one for each question in order: the labels the operator picked, an empty list when they picked none, and what they wrote, left out when they wrote nothing. Nothing is picked for them, and every question has a text box of its own, so add no option for "other".

context.description: Why you ask, in at most 600 characters.

options.description: Two to six options. Left out, the operator answers in their own words.

label.description: At most 60 characters, and no other option's.

recommended.description: True on at most one option, marked as your pick.

multiple.description: True if the operator may pick several options, or send with none picked. Otherwise they pick one, or write instead.
